Navigation

Ingresso a goccia

A method of entering a holding pattern in which the aircraft initially flies outbound on a course 30 degrees offset from the holding inbound leg, then turns inbound to intercept the holding course.

Quick answer: A method of entering a holding pattern in which the aircraft initially flies outbound on a course 30 degrees offset from the holding inbound leg, then turns inbound to intercept the holding course.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Ingresso a goccia?

In this glossary, Ingresso a goccia refers to: A method of entering a holding pattern in which the aircraft initially flies outbound on a course 30 degrees offset from the holding inbound leg, then turns inbound to intercept the holding course.

How is Ingresso a goccia used in aviation?

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Esegui ingresso a goccia nel holding su AGAMI e segnala quando sei inbound."

Definition

A method of entering a holding pattern in which the aircraft initially flies outbound on a course 30 degrees offset from the holding inbound leg, then turns inbound to intercept the holding course.

Operational example

Perform teardrop entry to the holding at waypoint AGAMI and report established inbound.
